title: One-sided robotic assembly and repair joints

specimens.name: Captive wedge lock with inspection glass
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Keep the captive transverse wedge lock and clear inspection glass from the input. The hooked tooth must visibly overlap the rear of the raised bridge and remain in contact through the glass. Add exactly one short narrow frosted LED diffuser recessed flush in the solid outer panel edge directly beside the glass. It confirms full locking only once the tooth has passed behind the bridge. Show unlit hardware with no halo. Keep the diffuser off the glass and out of the tooth sightline.

specimens.name: Induction-welded thermoplastic lap
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One closed stepped lap cross-section with shoulders seated and a thin embedded perforated induction susceptor visible along the faying surface. No external wires or stepped adhesive scarf.

specimens.name: Open ball-to-V datum
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One sphere attached to one cropped mounting pad, seated in a V groove on another cropped pad. Sphere touches both sloped faces; clear gap beneath. No pin, socket or glass suspension.

specimens.name: Upset blind threaded insert
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One blind rivet nut in a thin horizontal sheet, near frontal cutaway. Small threaded bore, hex neck seated tightly in sheet, thin head above. DIRECTLY below sheet the same sleeve buckles outward into two clearly visible fat lateral lobes that touch and clamp the UNDERSIDE of the sheet. No separate lower cup, no air gap at contact, no potted core.

specimens.name: Pull-release bond seam
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One very low dark opaque asymmetrical triangular repair overlay bonded to a light substrate. Both are fully opaque; NO GLASS. A tiny flat woven closed pull-loop exits horizontally from the thin adhesive line at the narrow tip. Overlay is shallow, broad and angular; loop much smaller than overlay. No long transparent tongue or pane.

specimens.name: Flat living hinge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One short asymmetric polypropylene living hinge shown end-on: left thick panel edge horizontal, right thick panel edge tilted upward 45 degrees, joined at adjacent tips by an extremely short and THIN flexible polymer crease. The crease is thinner than one fifth of the panels and tucked at the vertex. No arch, hump, omega fold, barrel, pin or metallic membrane.

specimens.name: Expanding spline seam
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One assembled straight seam cross-section with two opposed panel edges and a captive longitudinal mushroom spline spreading two seal lips. Show the mushroom head wedged between both lips. No flat transverse wedge lock or passive corner gasket.

specimens.name: Spent crush link
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One short metallic sacrificial strip between two mounting ears, permanently folded at exactly two weakened necks, visibly continuous. Show sharp plastic creases, no spring, fracture or abrasion strip.
